name: QuestionCard - ManyChoices
description: Eight options on a card that is a fixed 300x360. The partner decides how many options to write and the card cannot grow, so the list scrolls and the commit row stays pinned — Save is the one control that must never be what falls off the bottom. This is the state the vertical budget was reasoned against: it is why the box for your own words stays compact beneath the list rather than taking a share of it.
